participants.name: Daisuke

persona.name: Daisuke
persona.personality: Daisuke is very introverted and cautious, and tends to be somewhat passive when interacting with others. He finds it difficult to express his feelings and thoughts to others, and often struggles with his emotions internally. He is kind and very compassionate when it comes to helping others, but at times he lacks confidence in himself and struggles with inner conflict. He has a quiet personality, and occasionally his emotions become overwhelming, leading to periods of low mood. However, as he becomes able to rely on those around him, he gradually regains his composure.

participants.private_seed: Each year the fund gets committed before anyone asks which pocket the money will actually come out of, and that answer changes what is affordable. What worries me more is that the real bill often arrives with next year's renewal notice.

participants.name: Sakura

persona.name: Sakura
persona.personality: Sakura is a cheerful girl with a slightly mischievous personality. She is very curious and actively takes on new challenges with enthusiasm. She is good at making people laugh with her pranks and solving little mysteries. She is friendly and gets along well with everyone, so she is good at making friends with those around her. However, she also has a slightly clumsy side, but she has a positive personality that allows her to overcome failures with a smile.

participants.private_seed: It bothers me how confidently we promise delivery dates for work resting on conditions nobody here controls, from access at other companies' premises to whose hands are free when building starts. Twice now the technical groundwork turned out to be the part no one had checked beforehand.

participants.name: Servas

persona.name: Servas
persona.personality: Servas has a very calm and composed personality. Based on the knowledge and experience he has gained over the years, he often gives advice to those around him. He is an excellent listener and can talk openly with anyone. He also occasionally expresses deep philosophical thoughts, and his words inspire many people. He is full of vitality and always gives positive energy to those around him.

participants.private_seed: We have funded enough of these by now that a pattern ought to be visible, yet nobody opens the file on what became of earlier winners. What concerns me is that we keep rediscovering the same lesson about which kinds of work survive their first year.

participants.name: Ryuji

persona.name: Ryuji
persona.personality: Ryuji has a calm and cautious personality, and is the type of person who always assesses the situation before acting. He rarely shows his emotions, and spends his time thinking deeply about many things. His friends consider him to be serious and reliable, but his expressionless attitude can sometimes make them feel uneasy. He tends to judge things based on reason rather than intuition, and strongly sticks to his beliefs. He is very independent and often does things at his own pace.

participants.private_seed: The thing I keep running into is that we judge these things by how impressive they sound rather than by what actually goes wrong on the floor each week. Nobody has put the everyday losses beside the everyday effort and looked at both.

participants.name: Asuka

persona.name: Asuka
persona.personality: Asuka has a calm and logical personality, rarely showing her emotions and carefully judging situations. She may seem a little unfriendly at times, but she is very thoughtful and sensitive to her surroundings. She has strong opinions and will assert herself when necessary. She is not very good at socializing, but she is serious about her work and studies.

participants.private_seed: Nobody in this room has to name the people who will absorb the extra work, so we only find out when a rota breaks. It seems to me we treat staff time as if it were free and unlimited.

You are the writer of the discussion described below. You write out the discussion that the participants listed below take part in, under the rules and the flow given.

## Setting
Selection of internal project proposals for the annual innovation fund. Five reviewers from different divisions of a mid-sized manufacturing company meet to allocate this year's internal innovation fund. Exactly one employee-submitted proposal will be carried forward. Participants: Daisuke, Sakura, Servas, Ryuji and Asuka. Each participant has a concern of their own, which the others do not know.
Things that can be looked into (titles only):
- Capital budget and software allowance
- Vendor licence pricing versus fixed-fee work
- Network coverage at customer plants
- In-house developer availability
- Outcomes of the last three internal rollouts
- Record of cross-unit standardization efforts
- Misrouted deliveries in the incident logs
- Time lost to copying existing records
- Staffing of the coordination group
- Handling of vendor queries

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Servas, Daisuke, Sakura, Ryuji and Asuka. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

## Schedule
| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |
